Marco — following up on INV-8854 (due 6/15). Our AR team flagged that amount remains unpaid and we received an inbound note saying HelioMed is withholding the net due to a VAT / reverse-charge discrepancy on your side.

We need to understand the exact blocking docs so we can avoid escalation. Can you confirm: 1) the legal basis you are using to withhold (local code / PO clause), 2) whether you have a partial remittance queued and 3) ETA for full release?

We have uploaded preliminary remittance evidence to our portal and attached a screen capture (remittance_screenshot.jpg). Our treasury has committed to a staged remittance: 40% this week, 60% on receipt of the VAT clearance letter from our accountants (expected within 10 business days).

I appreciate you flagging urgency. If Redwood requires a formal letter from our tax counsel I can request it, but that will add time.

Regards,
